name: application-toggle-card-group
title: Toggle Card Group
description: Grid of selectable cards backed by native radio inputs, each showing a title, description, and a checkmark badge when selected.
useWhen: Choosing between a small number of options that each need a title and a short explanatory description.
Plan, tier, or mode selection where a rich card reads better than a plain radio list or button group.
You want the entire card to be clickable, not just a small radio dot.
avoidWhen: Options are short single words with no description — use radio-groups or a segmented control instead.
More than about 4-6 options are needed — a grid of description-bearing cards gets unwieldy; use a select or combobox instead.
Multiple options can be selected at once — swap the radio inputs for checkboxes and adjust the selection state accordingly.
responsiveBehavior: Cards stack in a single column on narrow viewports and lay out in a 3-column grid from the sm breakpoint up.
accessibility: Built on native <input type="radio"> elements grouped by a shared name, so arrow-key navigation and selection work without custom JavaScript.
The checkmark badge is aria-hidden since selection state is already exposed via the underlying radio input's checked state.
A visually hidden <legend> names the group for screen reader users.

variants.title: Toggle card group
variants.description: Three-card plan selector with title, description, and a checkmark badge on the selected card.
accessibility: The has-checked: variant styles the whole label, so the selected card is visually obvious without relying only on the small radio dot.

variants.title: Toggle card group (Dark)
variants.description: Toggle card group adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Selected-state border and checkmark colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
